name: Rintikode Assetnesia — Asset Inventory & QR Tracking
author: rintikode

sections.description:
Assetnesia Free stores asset records in your WordPress database. It includes:

  • Unlimited asset records.
  • Categories, units, and locations.
  • A basic asset dashboard.
  • One-at-a-time QR label generation and printing.
  • Public read-only asset lookup through an unguessable QR token.
  • Role-based access for asset managers, staff, and viewers.

There are no license checks, remote update services, quotas, or time limits in this plugin. An independently distributed Assetnesia Pro add-on can add maintenance workflows, movements and borrowing, advanced reports, import/export, audit logs, custom roles, Code 128 barcodes, and bulk label printing.

External services

Assetnesia Free does not send asset data, telemetry, or license information to external services.

Privacy

Asset and master-data records are stored in the site’s own WordPress database. Assetnesia Free does not transmit those records to Rintikode or another third party.

When an administrator prints a QR label, the QR code contains a public lookup URL with a randomly generated token. Anyone who has that URL can view only the fields enabled under Assetnesia > Settings. Administrators should avoid enabling sensitive fields and should treat printed labels as publicly readable.

Public lookup requests are rate-limited locally. The visitor IP address is hashed together with a short time window for rate limiting and is not stored as a permanent Assetnesia record.

Development source

Human-readable TypeScript and SCSS source is included under src/. The npm manifest and lock file required to reproduce the compiled files are included in the release package. Run npm ci followed by npm run build; generated assets are written to build/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/rintikode-assetnesia, or install it through WordPress.
  2. Activate Assetnesia.
  3. Open Assetnesia in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Is the number of assets limited?

No. Assetnesia Free does not impose an asset quota.

What happens if I remove the Pro add-on?

Core asset records remain available in Assetnesia Free. Pro-owned operational tables are retained unless the Pro add-on explicitly removes them.

Does Assetnesia send telemetry?

No. Assetnesia Free does not include telemetry, licensing calls, checkout requests, or a custom update service.

The optional Upgrade to Pro link opens the Rintikode purchase website only after an administrator clicks it. No site or asset data is sent automatically.

Where can I get support?

Use the Assetnesia support forum on WordPress.org. Do not post private asset records, credentials, or public lookup tokens in support topics.
sections.changelog:
0.5.2

  • Renamed the plugin to Rintikode Assetnesia with a new, distinctive WordPress.org slug and text domain.
  • Updated product links, interface branding, and Pro compatibility for the Assetnesia identity.

0.5.1

  • Added an explicit opt-in link from the Plugins screen to the external Assetnesia Pro purchase page.
  • Added privacy controls for fields exposed by public QR lookup pages.
  • Migrated plugin tables to collision-resistant names while preserving existing data.
  • Added optional complete data cleanup during uninstall.
  • Added third-party license notices and reproducible build metadata to the release package.

0.5.0

  • Separated the unrestricted Free plugin from the independently distributed Pro add-on.
  • Added WordPress-locale-aware administration screens.
